## Claude Code Review

This pull request is from a fork — automated review is disabled. A repository maintainer can comment `@claude review` to run a one-time review.

✅ **Gate recommendation: approve.**

Skipping empty and null inputs addresses the Bedrock rejection while preserving row alignment and the existing `on_bad_vectors` semantics. Mocked ingestion checks passed for all four policies, including batches containing only invalid texts.

**Documentation:** The [AWS Bedrock guide](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb/blob/63671e7eb45a2a1f8d3dfe700d5f077aaea63c9e/docs/web/integrations/embedding/aws.mdx) could mention that empty/null source text produces `None` and that `add()` applies the selected `on_bad_vectors` policy.
